quarterly_data.quarter: JX Advanced Metals press release: Further Expansion of Production Capacity for Liquid Leakage (10-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Liquid leakage detection systems (Sensor Business of group company TATSUTA Electric Wire and Cable): TATSUTA will make capital investments to further expand production capacity for liquid leakage detection systems used in AI data centers and other applications at its Kyoto Works (Fukuchiyama City, Kyoto Prefecture); the capacity enhancement will be implemented in phases, with production capacity expected to reach approximately 2.5 times the level at the end of 2026 by September 2027. The release says that after the expansion announced in August 2026 demand has continued to exceed expectations, driven by the spread of liquid cooling in AI data centers, and that the company is also considering further investments.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 2.5 times the level at the end of 2026 by September 2027
